title: Ecommerce Product Stage
description: Product detail stage with vertical image thumbnail rack, central visualizer, and checkout panel.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Product Gallery And Buy Box: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
